channel.title: Workplace Leader Weekly Agenda
channel.description: A weekly executive agenda for workplace leaders: Microsoft 365, identity and AI signals that pass the budget, risk and friction gate. By Phillip Büchler, ekston.ch.

item.title: Default-On AI vs. Deliberate Control
item.description: Over the next ten weeks Microsoft switches on AI features and AI spending unless someone says no. Claude arrives in Swiss and EU tenants on 9 December. Metered Copilot experiences show up from January, and pay-as-you-go billing for Copilot Business follows in Q1 2027. Each setting needs a decision and an owner before its date.

item.title: The 'Agentic Sprawl' vs. Centralised Governance Trap
item.description: Business units are building their own Copilot Studio agents faster than IT can track them, and each one is a new identity with access to company data. Freeze ad-hoc agent publishing and put every autonomous workflow under a credit budget and explicit Conditional Access, with a governed sandbox for the teams that want to keep building.
